'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Alex Klimenko LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex Klimenko]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
